diagnosed: REAL breakage still present in the escalation fast-lane: every research run DISPATCHED by scout/coverage-critic (`gh workflow run research-agent.yml -f tier=deep`, via scripts/escalate-research.js) fails. The claude-code-action@v1 step aborts with `Action failed with error: Workflow initiated by non-human actor: github-actions (type: Bot). Add bot to allowed_bots list or use '*' to allow all bots.` A GITHUB_TOKEN-issued `gh workflow run` makes the resulting run's actor `github-actions[bot]`, and the action rejects bot-initiated runs unless the bot is allow-listed. Re-confirmed this run on run 33248764003 (today 10:51, event=workflow_dispatch; both the deep Fable 5 step and the Opus 4.8 fallback hit `allowed_bots: ""` → rejection) and 33187753529 (08-28 15:58, same). The escalation lane has been dead ~1 week. SCHEDULED research (actor = last human to touch the cron) is unaffected and still runs; only the bot-dispatched escalation path is broken. Correct minimal fix identified: add `allowed_bots: "github-actions"` to the three `anthropics/claude-code-action@v1` steps in .github/workflows/research-agent.yml. This fix lives under .github/workflows/**, a protected automation path that scripts/hooks/protect-automation.js HARD-BLOCKS every CI agent (incl. self-repair) from editing — the block fired again on the Edit attempt this run. A human must author this one-line change; I could not open a PR. notes: SECOND CONSECUTIVE DETECTION — the 2026-08-28 self-repair run diagnosed this identical breakage and also abandoned (blocked by the same hook). This run re-verifies it is still broken and still blocked; the fix has not yet been authored by a human. Escalating the visibility: this needs an owner action, not another agent pass.

ROOT CAUSE: claude-code-action@v1 rejects runs whose triggering actor is a bot ('non-human actor: github-actions'). scout/coverage-critic escalate to research by dispatching research-agent.yml with the job's GITHUB_TOKEN (scripts/escalate-research.js line 38), which always runs as github-actions[bot]. So EVERY escalated research run — the coverage fast-lane's whole point — fails at the claude-code-action step. Scheduled research (human actor) is fine, which is why the board keeps updating and no other health signal flags it.

FIX (must be authored by a human — protected path): in .github/workflows/research-agent.yml, add `allowed_bots: "github-actions"` under `with:` on all three `uses: anthropics/claude-code-action@v1` steps (the standard-tier step, the deep-tier Fable 5 step, and the deep-tier Opus 4.8 fallback step). `"*"` also works but the tighter allow-list is preferred since only github-actions dispatches these, and workflow_dispatch already requires actions:write. That is the exact remedy the error message names.

WHY NO PR: scripts/hooks/protect-automation.js is CI-only and blocks Write/Edit to .github/workflows/** for any unattended agent — 'A human must author changes to these files.' The Edit was blocked by the hook, so branch+PR is impossible for this fix. This is by design (the hook is stricter than the self-repair prompt's 'make it, it'll wait for review'); surfacing to a human is the correct outcome.

VISUAL QA failures (recurring, e.g. run 32827302858 08-25) are a DIFFERENT cause — 'Claude execution failed: Reached maximum number of turns (40)' — not the bot rejection and not this mechanic's fix (turn-budget / prompt tuning is improve/visual-qa territory).
Non-bugs ruled out: publish-freshness fresh, validate-events 0 errors, npm test fully green, usage green. No pipeline/test-gate breakage to fix.
